notes: INCOMPLETE SOURCE: pages are numbered "Page N of 17" but the published PDF has only 13 pages. From the footers and the text continuity, the PDF holds printed pages 1-7, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16 and 17; pages 8, 9, 13 and 15 are missing. Consequently: the item "50 PAX FOOD & VENUE: (5 DAY LIVE-OUT) FOR TRAINING ON MOTOR ..." (end of page 7) and "60 BAGS CEMENT, AND ETC. FOR VARIOUS CONSTRUCTION ..." (end of page 12) have no visible amount; page 10 and page 14 begin mid-item (their first rows are tails of items begun on the missing pages; the printed amounts are kept); and the TRUST FUND heading plus its January-June items (except the last June item, "1 unit cut-off saw") are not visible. The utilization list is therefore partial and its items cannot be reconciled with the printed Total Utilization.

The printed Total Utilization 149,667,286.20 and Unutilized Balance (QRF 46,053,620.00; Mitigation 124,774,634.71; Total 170,828,254.71) are consistent with Section A (274,441,920.91 - 149,667,286.20 = 124,774,634.71). They are transcribed as printed. TOTAL MISMATCH: the visible utilization items alone sum to 167,192,904.04 (General Fund-MOOE 4,228,525.60; Continuing and Current Appropriation 109,677,029.68; Trust Fund 53,287,348.76), which already EXCEEDS the printed Total Utilization by 17,525,617.84 before adding the items on the four missing pages and the five unreadable amounts. So the printed total cannot include every listed item. In 2024-q3-ldrrmf the printed total omitted the Trust Fund July-September items (51,057,018.76, which are also listed here); the same omission may apply here, but with pages missing this cannot be verified.

Five amounts are overprinted by the "Page N of 17" footer and are recorded as null (see unreadable): "15% mobilization of contract for Repair and upgrade of DRRMO Bldg." (3,744,7??.?6), "75 PAX FOOD & VENUE ... EMERGENCY OPERATION CENTER TRANING COURSE" (157,5??.??), "900 PAX MEALS BREAKFAST ... PLAN EVENTS" (471,???.00), "44 PCS. ACRYLIC PLAQUE ... CITY WIDE FIRE OLYMPICS" (109,???.00) and "Payment of 45 pcs ballpen" (7??.??). The scan source is low resolution (975x637 px per page), so a re-render does not help.

Months: the CONTINUING AND CURRENT APPROPRIATION items after the November heading on page 7 are followed by missing pages, so the items on pages 10-14 have no month (a December heading may have been on a missing page). The Trust Fund item "1 unit cut-off saw" is assigned to June by its position (its June heading is on missing page 15; same item is under June in 2024-q3-ldrrmf).

January-September items repeat those of 2024-q3-ldrrmf and were re-checked against this report's pages. The four mitigation amounts 1,533,668.25 / 1,551,956.03 / 1,570,243.81 / 1,588,531.59 printed on the "CONTINUING AND CURRENT", "APPROPRIATION", "January-No Liquidation" and "February-No liquidation" rows have no item description and form an arithmetic series (+18,287.78 each), as in Q1-Q3.
The Special Trust Fund carry-over years (2019-2023) printed under the STF line sum to 191,948,705.65, not the STF line amount 29,850,466.23; transcribed as printed.
Particulars kept as printed, including typos (e.g. "EMBOSED", "WITHY", "T-SHHIRTS", "SUBMILATION", "TRASNPORTATION", "FIRS AID", "TRANING", "pacxked", "sphymamoter").
